<h2>Compute Predictor-Inclusive Variance Components</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Computes the full variance contribution associated with each predictor
domain without dividing shared fractions among domains.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>compute_predictor_inclusive_variance_components(data_source)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_source">data_source</code></td>
<td>
<p>A non-empty data frame with columns 'age', 'component', and
'R2_Nagelkerke'. Missing fraction labels are treated as zero, and negative
R-squared values are clamped to zero.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Each shared fraction contributes in full to every predictor domain that it
contains. Percentages use the sum of the seven clamped variance fractions
as their denominator, so percentages across domains may exceed 100 percent.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble with three rows per age and columns 'age', 'component',
'R2_Nagelkerke_predictor_inclusive', and
'R2_Nagelkerke_predictor_inclusive_percentage'.
</p>


<h3>See Also</h3>

<p>[compute_shapley_variance_components()]
</p>

</main>
